Hi Lena — thanks, that summary helps. Welcome aboard. I’m starting the vendor onboarding flow; to expedite, please complete the attached packet and return the items below:

Required items (to create vendor record and enable POs):
1) Completed W-9 or applicable tax form (PDF)
2) ACH form with bank routing/account and voided check (XLSX/PDF)
3) Certificate of insurance or evidence for commercial auto (if providing freight)
4) Legal entity proof (Articles of Incorporation or filing)
5) Primary AP contact and invoice format (PDF/one-line)

How we handle POs and timing:
- Once we have the completed onboarding packet and W-9, Finance (cc’d) can provision a vendor ID within 2 business days.
- PO issuance usually follows within 24–48 hours of vendor activation, subject to PO approval and account coding.
- Standard Redwood payment terms for third-party carriers are Net 30 unless alternate terms are negotiated in the SOW.

Next steps for you:
- Attach W-9 and ACH template to your reply (or upload to the Drive link below).
- Sign the vendor onboarding acknowledgement via DocuSign (link below).

Links & attachments:
- Onboarding packet (attached): "Vendor_Onboarding_Packet.pdf" and "ACH_Template.xlsx"
- Drive folder (for large files): https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-emeral-onboarding-docs
- DocuSign vendor acknowledgement: https://app.docusign.com/recipient/fake-sign-link-emerald
